4 Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice. (Philippians 4:4 KJV)

Paul is telling us to always have joy and praise for the Lord, and to be sure we don’t think he couldn’t really mean that, he repeated it.  This is the way a Christian should be, and it should be a way of life, as we are given the fruit of the spirit (Galatians 5:22-23), that includes joy and peace, when we are born again, and we have no excuse to not rejoice always.  If you are not rejoicing always, then you must be walking after the flesh instead of the spirit, or else you haven’t truly been born again.  Paul didn’t tell us to do this without doing it himself, as he was able to rejoice in the Lord through many bad times, and we can do the same if we keep our focus upon the Lord.  By giving all our cares over onto the Lord (Matthew 11:29-30), and keeping our minds upon the wonderful promises of God, we can stay full of joy.  The problem most people have, is that they stay focused on all the negative things of this world, and you can not do that and stay full of joy and peace.  Unplug from this world, and stay focused upon God.

You will find that if you keep walking with the Lord at all times then it is easy to rejoice in Him always, as He will keep you healthy, wealthy and wise.  When you give yourself to the Lord, and follow His leading, He gives you such peace and joy, through His love that it is easy to rejoice in Him always.  When you are full of God’s love, as God is love (1 John 4:8), you find that everything else in this world just doesn’t really matter that much, as you always come out a winner in God’s eyes.  So what if they tell you that you’re going to die, you get to go be with the Lord, and what’s bad about that?  If you keep your mind on the promise’s that God has given us, then it becomes easy to rejoice no matter what happens in your life, as in comparison to eternity, this life is just for a moment (2 Corinthians 4:17).  Keep full of the joy of God, and let your light shine (Matthew 5:16) so others can get to know Him also.  The way you live your life, may be the only bible that someone is reading.  Let your life be a witness for the Lord – Praise God for His many blessings!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
